in_sanskrit.name: Brya
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Rain
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Brya एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Brya is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Brihati', which is the name of a goddess associated with rain and the moon. The name carries the blessings of these celestial beings and is believed to bring prosperity and abundance.
